items.title: Joseph "One Eyed Babe" Phillips Interview, 1957-03-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You remember the big boy? ... He came down here and worked with the Eureka Band. ... [INTERVIEWEE] That's right.

ctx.x: I think his brother's name was Al Seed. You remember the big boy? Yeah. He came down here and worked with the Eureka Band. You remember all those fellas from up there?
